bloques.titulo: How the composite passé is formed
texto: It is formed with **avoir** or **être** in present + past participle: **j'ai parlé**, **elle est arrivée**. Most verbs use **avoir**; several motion verbs and pronominal verbs use **être**. Learn every verb with your assistant.
With **être**, the participle matches the subject: **il est arrivé**, **elle est arrivée**, **ils sont arrivés**. With **avoir**, at this level, it does not normally change: **elle a mangé**.
Example: **Nous sommes allés au cinéma** / **Elles sont allées au cinéma**.

The **imparfait** presents the background, a description, a state or a custom. The **passé composé** presents a delimited fact or a series of facts. It does not have to be sudden: **Hier, j'ai travaillé trois heures** is also delimited.
Example: **Il faisait beau quand le train est arrivé** (good weather when the train arrived).
